title: 暖冬为啥寒潮反而多？
title_en: A Warm Winter With More Cold Waves?

segments.en: The strongest El Niño on record
is charging up over the Pacific.

segments.zh: 可气象局说：今冬总体偏暖，
segments.en: Yet forecasters say this winter will be warmer overall,
with slightly more cold waves.
Warm and cold?

segments.zh: 这预报是不是自相矛盾？
segments.en: Is the forecast contradicting itself?

segments.zh: 十一月三日，中国气象局开发布会，
segments.en: On November third, the China Meteorological Administration held a briefing,
and it hit the trending lists.

segments.zh: 他们说，这次是有监测记录以来
segments.en: They said this is the strongest El Niño
since records began.
Today's brain teaser:

segments.zh: 暖冬来了，为啥羽绒服还不能收？
segments.en: if it's a warm winter, why keep the down jacket?

segments.zh: 先认识主角：一滴热海水，
segments.en: Meet our hero: a drop of warm sea water,
Little Niño.
El Niño is Spanish
for 'the little boy'.

segments.zh: 秘鲁渔民发现，每隔几年，
segments.en: Peruvian fishermen noticed that every few years,

segments.zh: 圣诞前后海水变暖，鱼也少了。
segments.en: the sea warmed around Christmas and the fish vanished.
Normally, the trade winds
blow across the Pacific from east to west.
They push the warm surface water

segments.zh: 一路推到印度尼西亚那边。
segments.en: all the way toward Indonesia.
So the sea surface in the west
sits about half a meter higher than in the east.
Off Peru in the east,

segments.zh: 深海冷水翻上来，鱼特别多。
segments.en: cold deep water wells up, and fish thrive.
Twist one: when the trade winds weaken,
the warm water sloshes back east.
Like water in a bathtub:
let go, and it sloshes back.

segments.zh: 于是大半个赤道太平洋
segments.en: So a huge stretch of the equatorial Pacific
heats up.
How big is the Pacific?

segments.zh: 占了地球表面的三分之一。
segments.en: About a third of Earth's surface.

segments.zh: 反转二：海水是个超级充电宝。
segments.en: Twist two: the ocean is a giant power bank.

segments.zh: 海面下几米的水，存的热就顶得上整个大气。
segments.en: The top few meters hold as much heat as the whole atmosphere.

segments.zh: 今年只用了大约五个月，就冲到超强；
segments.en: This year it went super strong in about five months.
Before, it took eight to fifteen.
China's National Climate Center says
it should peak in late autumn or early winter.
Once charged, it discharges:
heat seeps into the air, bit by bit.
When the air currents shift,
weather all over the world gets stirred.
The effect can last about half a year,
into next spring.

segments.zh: 对我们：全国气温总体偏高，
segments.en: For China: temperatures mostly above normal,
and much more rain and snow in the south.
Twist three, the most counterintuitive:
warmer does not mean warm every day.
Forecasters say: slightly more cold waves,

segments.zh: 冷暖起伏大，像坐过山车。
segments.en: big swings, like a roller coaster.

segments.zh: 打个比方：一周里三天零下五度，
segments.en: Picture a week with three days at minus five,
and four days at fifteen.
Average it out: over six degrees, not bad.

segments.zh: 可那三天，你冻得直哆嗦。
segments.en: But on those three days, you shiver.
Averages can fool you.
The swings are what bite.

segments.zh: 预报还说“前冬冷、后冬暖”，
segments.en: The forecast also says: colder early, warmer late,

segments.zh: 十二月、一月忽冷忽热最频繁。
segments.en: with the wildest swings in December and January.

segments.zh: 北方要防强降温和大雪，
segments.en: The north should watch for cold snaps and heavy snow,

segments.zh: 南方要防低温雨雪冰冻。
segments.en: the south for freezing rain and ice.

segments.zh: 内蒙古东北部和东北西部，
segments.en: Northeast Inner Mongolia and western Northeast China
may even run colder than usual.

segments.zh: 友情提示：这是季节预测，说的是可能性，
segments.en: Fine print: this is a seasonal forecast, about odds,
not a promise about any single day.

segments.zh: 专家也说：每次厄尔尼诺背景不同，
segments.en: Experts also say every El Niño is different,
so the effects never simply repeat.

segments.zh: 所以，暖冬为啥寒潮反而多？
segments.en: So why more cold waves in a warm winter?

segments.zh: 因为平均暖了，起伏却更大。
segments.en: The average rises, but the swings get bigger.
Keep your long johns handy.
Little Niño has only just started to discharge.

elements.text: 季节预测：说的是可能性
